transcript.answer: Otto's own WebSocket frame recorder was removed on 2026-10-21, when PR #431 was merged at 18:41 UTC. The PR closes issue #181. It deleted the recorder (`apps/api/src/testing/`), its test, the committed `hal-frames.json` fixture and the `record-frames` script. In its place, the web tests now replay `recordedFrames`, which HAL Engine exports from `@re-cinq/hal-engine` ^0.10.0 and re-records in its own CI. The new `apps/web/test/recordedFramesReplay.test.ts` covers four scenarios: simpleAnswer, thinkingThenTool, multiRoundSuppressed and rateLimited.
